_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Provider safety contract
requirements.description: Define cleanup providers with Estimate, Preview, Apply, Verify, safety tier, owner metadata, supported platforms, privilege requirements, irreversible effects, and test substitutes.

validation.notes: Provider metadata validation is covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-001].

requirements.title: No-real-cleanup test seams
requirements.description: Route every host effect through injected filesystem, process, Docker, journal, clock, and scenario-provider seams, with fakes and drift tests proving tests cannot delete files or run cleanup commands against the real host.

validation.notes: Production side-effect scanning is covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-002].

requirements.title: Policy-gated scan and plan
requirements.description: Produce deterministic scans and cleanup plans from provider estimates plus operator policy, including conservative defaults, provider versions, policy versions, approval requirements, and blocked Conditional or Forbidden actions.

validation.notes: Conservative policy gating is covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-003].

requirements.title: Replay-safe apply and audit
requirements.description: Apply only an approved exact plan with matching policy and provider versions plus idempotency key, return no-op on safe replay, and persist immutable redacted audit events.

validation.notes: Approval, policy-version, idempotency, replay, and audit behavior is covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-004].

requirements.title: CLI and API control surface
requirements.description: Expose scan, plan, provider catalog, policy get/set/list, apply, and audit list/show through stable CLI and API contracts with mutating commands marked confirmation-required.

validation.notes: Connect API plan, apply, audit, and error mappings are covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-005].
CLI cleanup command registration is covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-005].

requirements.title: Cross-platform verification honesty
requirements.description: Expose deterministic placement verification for linux, macos, and windows with synthetic foreign-platform identities and explicit declared absence.

validation.notes: Target-platform identity, path conventions, declared absence, and synthetic identity are covered by [REQ:CLN-P0-006].
